## `lr-time-zone-picker`

Style the label with `--lr-form-control-label-font-size`, `--lr-form-control-label-font-weight`, and
`--lr-form-control-label-color`.

Attribute `label-display` (`'visible'` default, or `'hidden'`) removes the label visually while it stays the accessible name; hint and error are unaffected (see "Hiding the label visually: `label-display`").

`labelPlacement: 'top' | 'start' = 'top'` (attribute `label-placement`, reflected) puts the label in an inline-start column sized by `--lr-form-control-label-inline-size` (default `30%`) and `--lr-form-control-label-gap` (default `var(--lr-space-m)`), returning above the field below `--lr-form-control-label-collapse-inline-size` (default `var(--lr-size-20rem)`); see "Label beside the field: `label-placement`".

A form-associated identifier selector. Import
`@aceshooting/lyra-ui/components/lr-time-zone-picker.js`. It follows the
[shared field contract](https://github.com/aceshooting/lyra-ui/blob/main/packages/lyra-ui/llms/components/lr-country-picker.md),
with `.timeZones` accepting
`LyraTimeZoneCatalog = readonly string[] | readonly LyraTimeZoneEntry[]`.
Default options are `UTC` followed by the runtime's supported primary IANA identifiers, or only
`UTC` when that catalog API is unavailable. Supply the same explicit catalog on server and client
when their time-zone data may differ. `value=''` selects nothing automatically.

Identifiers are trimmed and case-sensitive, limited to 256 characters, and never canonicalized.
Caller catalogs can retain aliases or custom identifiers. Default labels replace underscores
with spaces; `label` overrides provide other display names, and `searchable` matches both.
Selection does not change the application's time zone or calculate offsets, clocks or daylight
saving transitions. Catalog types and `getTimeZoneCodes()` are documented in the
[catalog helper reference](https://github.com/aceshooting/lyra-ui/blob/main/packages/lyra-ui/llms/forms.md#country-time-zone-and-unit-catalog-helpers).

The shared `part="limit"` notice uses `catalogPickerInputLimit` for original input omitted beyond
the 1,024-position catalog ceiling. It remains separate from popup row overflow. Snapshot rebinds,
fresh replacement/default clearing, quiet mounting/reconnection, and later polite announcements
follow the shared field contract.

**Field API:** `label`, `hint`, `errorText` (`error-text`), `placeholder`, `accessibleLabel`
(`aria-label`), `name`, `form`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `required`, `disabled`, `customError`
(`custom-error`), `size`, `clearable`, `searchable`, `topLayer` (`top-layer`),
`positioningStrategy` (`positioning-strategy`), `autocomplete`, `inputMode` (`inputmode`),
`enterKeyHint` (`enterkeyhint`), `spellcheck`, `autocapitalize`, `autocorrect`, and readonly `input`.
Defaults and form/editing methods follow the
[shared contract](https://github.com/aceshooting/lyra-ui/blob/main/packages/lyra-ui/llms/components/lr-country-picker.md), including
`getForm()`, `checkValidity()`, `reportValidity()`, `setCustomValidity(message)` and
`resetValidity()` for the owning form and consumer validation messages.

**Events:** `lr-change-request` (cancelable, `detail: { value, previousValue }`; vetoes or lets a
listener resolve a user choice or clear by assigning `value`, as in `lr-currency-picker`), `input`,
`lr-input`, `change`, `lr-change`, `focus`, `blur`, `lr-invalid`, `lr-load-error`.
On filter-load failure, `search-error` and `search-retry` expose the localized notice and retry
action. `--lr-form-control-invalid-border-color` themes the resting invalid border.
The popup emits `lr-show`, `lr-hide`, `lr-after-show`, `lr-after-hide`, `lr-activate`, and `lr-clear`
in both modes, following the country picker's event contract.
**Slots:** `label`, `hint`, `error`.
**CSS parts:** `form-control`, `form-control-label`, `hint`, `error`, `limit`, `select-trigger`,
`select-display-input`, `select-listbox`, `select-option`, `select-option-overflow`, `select-option-sub`, `select-group-label`,
`select-clear-button`, `search-error`, and `search-retry`.

```html
<script type="module">
  import '@aceshooting/lyra-ui/components/lr-time-zone-picker.js';
</script>
<lr-time-zone-picker name="zone" label="Time zone" value="UTC" searchable></lr-time-zone-picker>
```
